title: Order Check
statement: A build system has n tasks numbered 0 to n − 1 and rules [before, after] saying one task must run before another. Given a proposed order listing every task once, return true if it respects every rule.
constraints: order is a permutation of 0 to n − 1

answerKey.pattern: Record each task's position, then check every rule once
keyPoints: A rule [a, b] holds when pos[a] < pos[b]
edgeCases: A rule broken at the end of the list
acceptableSlowerApproaches: For each rule, search the order for both tasks: O(n · m)

hints: What do you need to know about each task to check a rule quickly?
Its position in the proposed order.
Build pos[], then check pos[a] < pos[b] for every rule.
